title: Teaching Children the Adab of Interaction and Tolerance

text_simplified: Parents must teach their children the adab of dealing with others, such as not mocking or harming them. The Prophet ﷺ said: 'A Muslim is the brother of another Muslim; he does not wrong him nor surrender him.' He also urged tolerance and avoiding anger. These values help build healthy relationships.

review_defects.why: The Arabic verb 'يسلمه' in this hadith means 'hand him over' or 'forsake him', not 'surrender him' which is ambiguous and may imply giving up in battle. The standard translation is 'does not hand him over' or 'does not forsake him'.
